What is this chapter about?

What to look for:
  • Do teams explore all of the available resources?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.
This chapter does not require a debrief. Use the slides to introduce Chapter 2.

What is this chapter about?
Teams meet with both Blaine and Grace to get a better understanding of the various stakeholders at ForgePro. Teams take notes that they can reference later on.

What to look for:
  • Do teams talk with both Blaine and Grace?
  • Do they unlock additional information by asking specifically about each of the other stakeholders?
  • Do they take notes that will be useful to them in the next chapter?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to give participants a helpful reminder:

Remember to spend time talking with both Blaine and Grace. It may help to ask specific questions about each stakeholder.

Debrief Reminder: This is a very quick debrief.
  • Use the slides to note that Blaine and Grace might have shared additional information, or even conflicting information.
  • Then move directly to the next chapter.

What is this chapter about?
Teams use the included tool to map who has what sort of influencing power at ForgePro.

What to look for:
  • Do teams complete the Stakeholder Mapping Tool?
  • Are teams thoughtfully considering the various types of influencing power?

    Note: There will be only a few updates in the Activity Feed during this chapter.
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to give participants a helpful reminder:

People often have more than one type of influencing power. Just try to identify their primary source of power.

What is this chapter about?
Teams email Mei to propose their strategy for influencing key stakeholders to embrace the SmartSense technology.

What to look for:
  • Do teams explain which stakeholders are the most important for this initiative?
  • Do they clearly express who should be approached first, and why?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.
